nodes.title: bay
nodes.equation: x_fs = forward stop aft face; bay L = x_as - x_fs; H = (base + H - t) - (base + t + floor stack); x_nose_in = pod LE + t; nose block = (x_fs - t_fs) - x_nose_in; centroid against the forward stop = x_fs + L_pack/2 ; nominal / heavy centroid = aft face - L_pack/2 ; spacer = x_as - aft face ; block B (nominal) = (aft_nom - L_pack - t_sp) - x_fs ; block section = bw (zh - tray top) - groove ; aft reach = x_as - L_pack/2 ; travel = bay L - L_pack

nodes.title: station
nodes.equation: most forward centroid that keeps C5's block B = x_fs + t_sp + L_B + L_pack/2 ; station range = aft reach - that ; spacer sum >= range

nodes.title: recess
nodes.equation: x0: upper surface z(x) = pod base; depth = z(x_end) - base, x_end = spar x - r - wall; foam under = base - lower surface z(x_end)

nodes.title: cad
nodes.equation: read-outs of pod.py#layout(): pad clearance, antenna A / B to pack, GPS to nearest power item

nodes.title: straps
nodes.equation: capacity = n straps x installed loop capacity

nodes.title: pod crash
nodes.equation: F = (pod + avionics + power - nominal pack + heaviest pack listing) x n_crash x g

nodes.title: ties
nodes.equation: capacity = n ties x tie rating

nodes.title: handle
nodes.equation: F_ult = gate mass x g x handling factor x ultimate factor

nodes.title: pitot
nodes.equation: boom length = socket inner end - tip x; exposed = pod LE - collar - tip x

nodes.title: mast bolt
nodes.equation: past the grip = bolt length - grip ; nyloc-rule equivalent: >= 5.0 mm (C6 E-POD-06)

nodes.title: mass
nodes.equation: pod mass = sum of the CAD part masses
